transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I'm here because I've been hearing voices and seeing things that other people tell me aren't actually there. It's really confusing and scary, and I just want it to stop.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your mood, such as feeling extremely happy or irritable, or extremely sad, in relation to these experiences?

No, I haven't really noticed any extreme highs or lows like that. I just feel pretty scared and confused because of the voices and things I'm seeing, but my mood itself hasn't been unusually happy or sad.
How long have you been experiencing the voices and visions, and have they occurred at the same time as any periods of depressed mood, or have they happened independently of your mood?

I've been hearing the voices and seeing those things for about a year and a half now. I haven't really noticed any connection to depression, and they seem to just happen regardless of how I'm feeling.

Have you experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed, lost interest in activities you usually enjoy, or had changes in appetite, sleep, or energy, either currently or at any point in the past?
No, I haven't ever experienced a period of feeling depressed or losing interest in things I enjoy. I also haven't had any of those changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels.
How have these voices and visions affected your daily life, such as your relationships, work, or ability to take care of yourself?
It's just really hard to focus on anything when the voices and visions are happening. I'm not entirely sure how to describe it, but it makes doing normal daily things feel very difficult.

Based on what you've shared, it sounds like the voices and visions have significantly impacted your daily life. Can you tell me more about how you've been coping with these experiences and if you've noticed any patterns or triggers that make them better or worse?
I'm not really sure what triggers these experiences or how to make them any better. I haven't found a good way to cope with them either, other than just trying to get through the day.

Can you tell me more about the content of the voices and visions you're experiencing, such as what the voices are saying or what you're seeing, and whether they seem to be related to any specific themes or ideas?

The voices usually whisper negative things to me, sometimes commenting on what I'm doing or telling me I'm not safe. As for what I see, it's mostly shadowy figures standing in the corners of rooms that disappear when I try to look directly at them.

How have these experiences, including the voices and visions, affected your ability to maintain relationships, work, or engage in activities you once enjoyed, and have you had to make any significant changes to your daily routine as a result?
I'm not really sure how to explain how it has affected my relationships or work. It's just hard to keep up with things, but I don't know how to describe the impact it's had on my routine.
Do you believe the voices and visions are real, or do you think they might be a product of your own mind, and have you ever acted on the instructions or messages from the voices?
I'm really not sure if they are real or just in my mind because they feel so vivid to me. I don't think I've ever acted on what the voices tell me to do, but it is just really hard to explain.
Is there anything else you'd like to share or discuss about your experiences, or any questions you have for me before we conclude our conversation today?
No, I don't think I have anything else to add right now, and I don't have any questions. Thank you so much for your time and for listening to me today.

Further evaluation is needed to determine the presence of any depressive symptoms that may not be immediately apparent and to differentiate between these diagnoses.
